_note: The daily shortlist's rankings. Edit freely: `default` picks the one shown first, `n` how many rows (the page lets you change it up to `max_n`). Every recipe is built and forward-tracked each night, so the alternatives keep competing. Evidence: data/_shortlist_backtest.json (2026-11-08). Research screens, not investment advice.

recipes.name: fund_score
recipes.label: Fundamental score
recipes.evidence: Best tested: top 20 at support beat every at-support name by +0.22% a trade on 2022-26 at the open (t 2.21) and held in 2018-19 and 2020-21; with the limit rule +0.24% (not significant).

recipes.name: combo_h60
recipes.label: Combo score (3 months)
recipes.evidence: +0.20% a trade on 2022-26 at the open (t 1.56); mixed in 2018-21. Promising, not proven.

recipes.name: combo_h20
recipes.label: Combo score (1 month)
recipes.evidence: +0.17% a trade on 2022-26 at the open (t 1.47); mixed in 2018-21. Promising, not proven.

recipes.name: limit_ready
recipes.label: Furthest above the level (limit-ready)
recipes.evidence: With the limit order: +1.20% a trade on 2022-26 (t 1.87) but only 17% of orders filled, and -1.8% in 2018-19. Unstable.

recipes.name: gain_days
recipes.label: Hottest (top-20 gainer days)
recipes.evidence: The 10-23 list's rule: no measured edge (-0.09% at the open, +0.43% with the limit, both not significant); more stop-outs.

recipes.name: insider_score
recipes.label: Insider buying
recipes.evidence: No measured edge at support (-0.07% at the open, +0.25% with the limit).

recipes.name: sentiment
recipes.label: News sentiment (30 days)
recipes.evidence: No measured edge at support (+0.11% at the open, +0.14% with the limit).

recipes.name: low_vol
recipes.label: Calmest first
recipes.evidence: No edge: -0.11% at the open, -0.34% with the limit.

recipes.name: rally_count
recipes.label: Most separate rallies
recipes.evidence: No edge: -0.25% at the open, +0.17% with the limit.

recipes.name: recovery_rate
recipes.label: Dips won back
recipes.evidence: No edge: +0.13% at the open, +0.08% with the limit.

recipes.name: growth_score
recipes.label: Growth score
recipes.evidence: No edge: +0.07% at the open, -0.30% with the limit (and -0.65% on 2018-21).
